master.attribution: the pipeline figures above are the desk strike's own report, carried as reported. The intake desk's in-memory reconstruction of the pre-Sigma master reproduced lufs_before, gain_applied_db, trim_db and ceiling_overrode_loudness EXACTLY, at an identical frame count (8,596,585), but its pipeline true-peak read of that intermediate is -1.40 dBTP, 0.11 dB from the desk-reported -1.51. The discrepancy is confined to that one intermediate figure — an estimator difference on a file that was never delivered — and is marked here, not resolved by preference. The delivered master itself reads -1.49 dBTP by the same estimator (verification block), agreeing with the desk's reported final figure.

notes: loudness is K-weighted integrated, UNGATED (BS.1770 gating omitted in the house scales, stated not hidden).

the ceiling is law: this time it did not have to win — the trim is 0.0 dB and ceiling_overrode_loudness is false in the desk's report; the mastered loudness stands at the -14.0 target exactly, verified from the delivered file.

no head or tail fades: those belong to the performance chain's assembly of takes; an intake master of a finished render leaves the waveform's edges as struck. The strike's own closing fall (last segment -47.1 dB, slope -12.44 dB/s) is the performance's, untouched.

nothing else rides and nothing was removed: no EQ, no width process, no edit of any kind between decode and the loudness/ceiling law — the one addition is the confessed Sigma fixture in the sigma block above.

the master was struck by the desk at the founder's request to hear it, ahead of this manifest; the intake desk's part was verification, and the verification is printed where it stands (master.attribution, sigma.residual_verification).

sigma.added_by: the desk, at the strike of the master, 2026-11-10
sigma.authority: the brief's own order (a binaural Sigma layer embedded from the first bar to the last) + the founder's embedded-Sigma standing order + the closed Fixtures A/B law (ear verdict 2026-11-10: a house Sigma pair may ride a Gemini master — studio-runs/gemini-hood-elegance/fixtures-ab/)
sigma.basis_in_the_strike: the strike's own ordered layer read NOT CERTIFIABLE by both probes (analysis-stats.json). Fixed seats at the doctrine pair: L @ 200 Hz median 0.89 dB, persistence 0.090; R @ 213 Hz median 3.85 dB, persistence 0.191 — the bar is >= 10 dB median AND >= 0.90 persistence in BOTH channels. Sweep probe (for the ordered 13-31 Hz sweep): pair persistence 0.972 and median line ratios 16.56 dB (L) / 15.77 dB (R), but median interaural difference 0.0 Hz, IQR 0.5 Hz, and only 2.9 % of pair windows inside 13-31 Hz — the tracked lines are the programme's own centred tones, identical in both ears.
sigma.confession: what rides is a CONSTANT 13.0 Hz pair, NOT the brief's ordered 13-31 Hz sweep. The house does not counterfeit the sweep: the strike was ordered to perform it and did not certifiably do so, so the proven fixture fulfils the founder's embedded-Sigma order in the only form the house has proven, and this block says so in the open.
sigma.recipe: the house Proven Road fixture, exactly as fixtures_ab.py built it: constant sine pair, 200 Hz left / 213 Hz right (13.0 Hz binaural beat), amplitude = mastered-bed RMS x 10^(-28/20); mastered bed RMS 0.1578, pair amplitude 0.00628

residual_verification.method: fixtures method, run by the intake desk against the DELIVERED master: the pre-Sigma master was reconstructed in memory by the same recipe (decode, resample 44.1->48 kHz, master_signal -14/-1) — frame count identical to the delivered file (8,596,585) and pipeline figures reproduced (see master.attribution) — and subtracted. The residual is therefore the ride alone, sample-aligned; peak-picking the mix itself would find the programme's tones, not the pair.
residual_verification.reading: every one of the 90 probed windows reads the pair at its seats; the residual's RMS equals the pair's own sine RMS in both channels, i.e. the delivered master differs from the pre-Sigma master by the confessed fixture and by nothing else above 24-bit quantisation dust.

sigma.trim_after_ride: none applied — the desk's executed build needed none: loudness measured -14.0 LUFS before the ride and -14.0 LUFS after it (the pair's contribution is below the manifest's 0.01 LU resolution). The Fixtures A/B previews were RMS-matched because loudness could not be allowed to decide that verdict; a delivery master is not an A/B, and the difference is stated rather than smoothed.

width.reason: no stems exist; two lead voices ride the mid and bleed into what side signal there is, so any widening available to this desk would move the vocal image with the bed. The strike's image is also the widest of the three adopted-road intakes (corr 0.862 against the Anvil bar's 0.9293). The conservative correction cannot be shown to leave the vocals untouched — the doubt is real, so width is left as struck, confessed. The side-RMS change (-25.87 to -27.63) is the -1.78 dB master gain plus the ride's small side contribution, not a width process.
